# A flat add-on price can still be a losing job.

> Free calculator for wedding and event photographers: net profit and effective hourly rate for each package add-on after editing time, gear and subcontractor costs.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/photo-addon-pricing-calculator/)
- [Is a second shooter worth it?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/photo-addon-pricing-calculator/is-a-second-shooter-worth-it.html)
- [This calculator vs. pricing an add-on by comparing to what other studios charge](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/photo-addon-pricing-calculator/vs-pricing-by-comparing-to-other-studios.html)
